drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

recovery141.scope: Original pixels replay every decision before independent scoring. Baseline139 accepted tracker proposals remain unchanged; the shared filter can still refuse supplemental boxes. No semantic identity or automatic admission.
